name: Vydeo Clips
description: Save YouTube clips, notes, tags, and reaction timelines by timestamp without downloading video files.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://noembed.com https://studio.vydeo.org https://www.youtube.com; img-src 'self' data: https://img.youtube.com https://i.ytimg.com https://*.ytimg.com; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com;
